question: Does giving the model up to three plans per mission (the original plus two replans after a vehicle rejection) change the results?
change: Replanning: when the vehicle refuses a step or a wait does not confirm, plan again with the reason, up to three plans (harness/replan.py).
also_changed: Gateway re-evaluates a retried definite rejection instead of replaying it (both models).
Stop reasons renamed: binding_broken split into step_rejected / step_unconfirmed / approval_void (both models).
Trace lines carry a source field (both models).
Simulator reset ~90 s -> ~50 s (Sonnet only; the qwen baseline already had it).
